# Worthing Loft Conversion Planning Handbook

> Plain-English guide to planning permission, permitted development, building regulations, party walls and bat surveys for loft conversions in Worthing and Adur, West Sussex.

Published by Worthing Loft Conversions, 01903 941899. Covers Worthing, Goring-by-Sea, Durrington, Broadwater, West Tarring, High Salvington, Findon Valley, Heene, West Worthing, Sompting, Lancing, Ferring, Shoreham-by-Sea, Rustington, East Preston. Main website: https://worthingloftconversions.co.uk

## Pages

- [Bats and surveys before a loft conversion in Worthing](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/bats-and-surveys/): Why bats matter in a loft conversion, when an ecologist is needed, and the other surveys that come first in Worthing and West Sussex.
- [Building regulations for a Worthing loft conversion: fire, structure, insulation and stairs](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/building-regulations/): What Building Regulations require for a loft conversion in Worthing: structure, fire safety, insulation, stairs, Building Control stages and fees.
- [Conservation areas and Article 4 Directions for Worthing lofts](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/conservation-areas/): How conservation areas and Article 4 Directions in Tarring, Central Worthing, Marine Parade and Goring-by-Sea affect a loft conversion.
- [Loft conversion glossary for Worthing homeowners](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/glossary/): Plain definitions of the loft conversion terms used in Worthing: dormer, hip-to-gable, mansard, permitted development, Article 4, party wall and more.
- [Loft conversion rules in Worthing: planning, building regulations and party walls](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/): A plain-English handbook to the rules for a loft conversion in Worthing: permitted development, planning, building regulations, party walls and bats.
- [Party wall rules for loft conversions in Worthing](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/party-walls/): How the Party Wall etc. Act 1996 applies to a loft conversion on a Worthing terrace or semi, who has to be told, and what happens if a neighbour objects.
- [Permitted development for loft conversions in Worthing](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/permitted-development/): What permitted development allows for a loft conversion in Worthing: 40 and 50 cubic metre volume limits, height, materials, side windows and when the right does not apply.
- [Planning permission for a loft conversion in Adur and Worthing](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/planning-in-adur-and-worthing/): When a loft conversion in Adur and Worthing needs a planning application, who decides, what it costs and what the South Downs National Park changes.
- [Loft conversion timeline in Worthing: survey to sign-off](https://worthingloftconversions.github.io/timeline/): The order of a loft conversion in Worthing from survey to completion certificate, with which approvals run in parallel.
